questions.question: You’re at a café and your friend’s coffee is too hot. What would be the most appropriate response to say to them?
options: Don’t worry about it. It’s fine.
I’m sorry, I didn’t realise it was so hot.
You should have asked for it to be made colder.
This is your fault—you should have checked the temperature.
questions.answer: I’m sorry, I didn’t realise it was so hot.

questions.question: Your colleague suggests, ‘Let’s meet tomorrow afternoon at 3 PM.’ How would you politely respond if you can’t make it?
options: That’s great, I’ll definitely be there.
I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it—my schedule’s full.
You’re too kind; I’ll try to come if I can.
3 PM is perfect for me, but I’ll bring coffee.
questions.answer: I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it—my schedule’s full.

questions.question: Someone asks, ‘Would you like to go to the cinema with me this weekend?’ What is the most appropriate way to suggest an alternative activity?
options: No, I don’t like movies. Let’s go hiking instead.
I’d love to, but I’ve already planned something else.
That sounds fun, but I’ll just stay home and watch TV.
Maybe another time? I’m busy this weekend.
questions.answer: No, I don’t like movies. Let’s go hiking instead.

questions.question: Your friend is complaining about a slow internet connection. How would you respond to express agreement and offer a solution?
options: That’s not a problem—just enjoy your time online!
I totally agree! Let’s try moving to a café with better Wi-Fi.
It’s probably nothing; it’ll sort itself out soon.
You should just accept that you’ll have to deal with it.
questions.answer: I totally agree! Let’s try moving to a café with better Wi-Fi.

questions.question: In a formal business email, your manager asks, ‘Could you provide the report by Friday?’ What is the most appropriate way to politely request an extension?
options: I’ll finish it as soon as possible, but I might need a couple of days more.
Yes, I’ll send it right away—just give me a few more hours.
I’m sorry, but I can’t complete it by Friday—I’ll send it next week instead.
The deadline is too tight; I’ll do my best to meet it on time.
questions.answer: I’m sorry, but I can’t complete it by Friday—I’ll send it next week instead.
